Subject: Weekly forecast standup + stage cleanup

Hey team,

Quick reminder: forecast submission for finance is due EOD Friday. I ran a scan this morning and noticed several commit-stage deals that still have out-of-date close dates or are sitting in "Proposal" for multiple weeks. Please do the following by end of day today so our call is productive: 

- Update stage to reflect current status (Proposal, Contracting, Committed).
- Adjust close dates to the best estimate and add a short note explaining the change.
- Flag any deals you want on the QBR review list with the tag "QBR-Review".

Attached: Q3_commit_spreadsheet.xlsx with the current commit view and a one-page stage-cleanup-checklist.pdf.

Call at 3pm PT — agenda below (30 min):
1) Rapid hygiene pass (5–10 min)
2) Top 6 commit reviews (15 min)
3) Any escalations/ask list (5–10 min)

If you can't make 3pm, ping me now and share updates in the sheet. I will start the call with the commit roll-up.

Thanks,
Dylan
